historical_evidence.source: D065 observed readback split; no new measurement
historical_evidence.limit: Historical min(transfer-related host,CPU encoding) ceiling only. Instrumentation overhead, startup/tail, CPU/memory contention and new implementation costs prevent claiming a current attainable gain.

source_findings: sync_to_cpu serializes four DMA copies and per-node encoding, reusing one cached page-locked PinnedBuf sized to the largest device arena. sync_strategy is a separate path.

PinnedBuf already exposes slices over registered host memory. Cudarc0.19.7 memcpy_dtoh invokes async transfer; its [T] HostSlice guard is Sync(None), so it does not insert a hidden wait. The existing explicit stream wait causes serialization. No new raw CUDA transfer API is required.

TreeBuilder reserves each player action data offset and node before children. GpuPlan assigns packed offsets in node order; full fallback uses original offsets. Thus complete-node copy/encode groups can be contiguous in device order without splitting a node scale calculation.

Compact active blocks carry node/host/device/length metadata, and inactive snapshots are restored separately. Full layouts have no active vector, so their chunk ranges must use the existing tree nodes rather than allocate a per-node table.

The existing per-node Store.write_f32 encoder can be reused unchanged after each completed chunk; no numerical CUDA or f32 arithmetic change is needed. F32 storage and small/unsuitable layouts can retain the exact old path.

proposed_fixed_design_before_any_candida.scope: Large compressed sync_to_cpu only. Keep sync_strategy, F32 and insufficient/unsuitable chunk layouts on original code.
proposed_fixed_design_before_any_candida.memory: Partition the existing PinnedBuf into two disjoint windows. No new pinned allocation, GPU allocation, stream, kernel or module. Only bounded chunk descriptors may be added.
proposed_fixed_design_before_any_candida.schedule: Drain preceding GPU work; copy first complete-node chunk and wait. Queue next chunk into the other window before encoding current. Wait before reading the next window and alternate. Restore inactive snapshots once after all active writes, then publish iteration/symmetry exactly as before.
proposed_fixed_design_before_any_candida.safety: Validate full coverage, monotone offsets, checked ranges and complete-node boundaries before queueing. Keep CPU reads and DMA destinations disjoint. A scope guard must drain any outstanding copy on errors/unwind before the pinned allocation can be released.
proposed_fixed_design_before_any_candida.parameters: Eight chunks and16MiB minimum are prospective amortization choices, not a validated optimum or a claim of no slowdown. They must be frozen before timing; no outcome-based threshold tuning.

required_next_evidence: Review bounded implementation and its fallbacks before activation. Preserve original full-copy reference.

Force the same pipeline helper on small full/compact compressed controls with test-only policy; compare complete raw q/scales, GPU data, iteration, queries/saves, inactive materialization and repeated sync. Retain F32 and tiny/unsuitable fallbacks.
Exercise boundary/chunk coverage and drain behavior after a queued copy. Prove existing pinned/device byte counts unchanged.
Only then run a separately fixed full-cycle1% screen; passing still requires16-pair confirmation, broader exactness, fixed holdout and cumulative/resource checks.
deferred_alternatives: Do not rescue E039 or introduce fixture-name/street-based shader selection. No new CUDA work is started by this source note.
